case.name: standard_expressions
case.query: select <% a | upper %> as a, <% 1 + 2 * 3 %> as b, '<% a ~ '-' ~ b %>' as c, <% n | int + 1 %> as d, '<% 'x' if n == '2' else 'y' %>' as e, '<% [1, 'a'] %>' as f, '<% none %>' as g, '<% true %>' as h, <% 7 / 2 %> as i, '<% a | replace('q', 'z') | title %>' as k, '<% (a, n) | join(',') %>' as l, <% n | length %> as m

statements: select Q as a, 7 as b, 'q-r' as c, 3 as d, 'x' as e, '[1, 'a']' as f, 'None' as g, 'True' as h, 3.5 as i, 'Z' as k, 'q,2' as l, 1 as m
